description: This is a unit test class for the DestroyPurgeStrategy component of the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the purge functionality related to employee pictures within the maintenance purge strategy module.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the behavior of DestroyPurgeStrategy, focusing on the purge operation that deletes employee pictures from the database.
